arxiv-2101-05554.title: Gradient inequality and convergence of the normalized Ricci flow
arxiv-2101-05554.creator: Nikos I. Kavallaris, Takashi Suzuki
arxiv-2101-05554.description: Abstract . We study the problem of convergence of the normalized Ricci flow evolving on a compact manifold Ω \Omega without boundary. In [ 11 , 12 ] we derived, via PDE techniques, global-in-time existence of the classical solution and pre-compactness of the orbit. In this work we show its convergence to steady-states, using a gradient inequality of Łojasiewicz type.

arxiv-2201-10894.title: Nonlinear optical response of Type-II Weyl fermions in two dimensions
arxiv-2201-10894.creator: Yaraslau Tamashevich, Leone Di Mauro Villari, Marco Ornigotti
arxiv-2201-10894.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yaraslau Tamashevich, Leone Di Mauro Villari, Marco Ornigotti. We present a theoretical model to study the nonlinear optical response of materials with a low-energy spectrum characterised by strongly tilted, type-II, Weyl cones in two dimensions, which we call 2D Weyl materials. Our findings reveal that the tilted nature of the Weyl cones is responsible for the appearance of even harmonics in the nonlinear signal, as well as its strong polarisation dependence.

arxiv-2204-06283.title: NAACL 2022 Curriculum : A Broad-Coverage Benchmark for Linguistic Phenomena in Natural Language Understanding
arxiv-2204-06283.creator: Zeming Chen, Qiyue Gao
arxiv-2204-06283.description: Abstract In the age of large transformer language models, linguistic evaluation play an important role in diagnosing models’ abilities and limitations on natural language understanding. However, current evaluation methods show some significant shortcomings. In particular, they do not provide insight into how well a language model captures distinct linguistic skills essential for language understanding and reasoning.

arxiv-2210-06576.title: DATScore: Evaluating Translation with Data Augmented Translations
arxiv-2210-06576.creator: Moussa Kamal Eddine, Guokan Shang, Michalis Vazirgiannis
arxiv-2210-06576.description: Abstract The rapid development of large pretrained language models has revolutionized not only the field of Natural Language Generation (NLG) but also its evaluation. Inspired by the recent work of BARTScore: a metric leveraging the BART language model to evaluate the quality of generated text from various aspects, we introduce DATScore.

arxiv-2303-00526.title: CORRELACIÓN DE MATERIAL PARTICULADO P ​ M 2.5 PM_{2.5} EN FUNCIÓN A LA HUMEDAD RELATIVA - PRECIPITACIÓN USANDO Python, EN LA CIUDAD DEL CUSCO

arxiv-2303-00526.description: Abstract El presente estudio utiliza datos correspondientes al promedio de concentración mensual de material particulado 2.5 ( P ​ M 2.5 PM_{2.5} ), humedad relativa y precipitación durante el periodo 2016-2018 recolectados por la estación High Vol del Centro de Energía y Atmósfera - UNSAAC, y el centro meteorologico SENAHMI (Kayra-UNSAAC).

arxiv-2401-16797.title: Enhancing Translation Validation of Compiler Transformations with Large Language Models
arxiv-2401-16797.creator: Yanzhao Wang and Fei Xie
arxiv-2401-16797.description: Abstract This paper presents a framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) into translation validation, targeting LLVM compiler transformations where formal verification tools fall short. Our framework first utilizes existing formal verification tools for translation validation. In this work, we use Alive2, a well-known tool in LLVM compiler verification, as an example.

arxiv-2403-17389.title: Quantum-Enhanced Simulation-Based Optimization for Newsvendor Problems
arxiv-2403-17389.creator: Monit Sharma 1, Hoong Chuin Lau 1,2, Rudy Raymond 3,4
arxiv-2403-17389.description: Abstract Simulation-based optimization is a widely used method to solve stochastic optimization problems. This method aims to identify an optimal solution by maximizing the expected value of the objective function. However, due to its computational complexity, the function cannot be accurately evaluated directly, hence it is estimated through simulation.

arxiv-2406-16404.title: Bijections between Variants of Dyck Paths and Integer Compositions
arxiv-2406-16404.creator: Manosij Ghosh Dastidar, Michael Wallner
arxiv-2406-16404.description: Abstract We give bijective results between several variants of lattice paths of length 2 ​ n 2n (or 2 ​ n − 2 2n-2 ) and integer compositions of n n , all enumerated by the seemingly innocuous formula 4 n − 1 4^{n-1} . These associations lead us to make new connections between these objects, such as congruence results.

arxiv-2408-06128.title: Effect of low-temperature compression on superconductivity and crystal structure in strontium metal
arxiv-2408-06128.creator: J. Lim, S. Sinha, D. E. Jackson, R. S. Kumar, C. Park, R. J. Hemley, D. VanGennep, Y. K. Vohra, R. G. Hennig, P. J. Hirschfeld, G. R. Stewart, J. J. Hamlin
arxiv-2408-06128.description: Abstract The superconducting and structural properties of elemental strontium metal were investigated under pressures up to 60 GPa 60\text{\,}\mathrm{G}\mathrm{P}\mathrm{a} while maintaining cryogenic conditions during pressure application. Applying pressure at low temperatures reveals differences in superconducting and structural phases compared to previous reports obtained at room temperatures.

arxiv-2412-10337.title: Generative AI in Medicine
arxiv-2412-10337.creator: Divya Shanmugam 1 , Monica Agrawal 2,3 , Rajiv Movva 1 , Irene Y. Chen 4,5 , Marzyeh Ghassemi 6 , Maia Jacobs 7,8 , and Emma Pierson 1,9
arxiv-2412-10337.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Divya Shanmugam 1 , Monica Agrawal 2,3 , Rajiv Movva 1 , Irene Y. Chen 4,5 , Marzyeh Ghassemi 6 , Maia Jacobs 7,8 , and Emma Pierson 1,9. The increased capabilities of generative AI have dramatically expanded its possible use cases in medicine. We provide a comprehensive overview of generative AI use cases for clinicians, patients, clinical trial organizers, researchers, and trainees.

arxiv-2501-18372.title: Implications of the multi-minima character of molecular crystal phases onto the free energy
arxiv-2501-18372.creator: Marco Krummenacher, Martin Sommer-Jörgensen, Moritz Gubler, Jonas A. Finkler, Ehsan Rahmatizad Khajehpasha, Giuseppe Fisicaro, Stefan Goedecker
arxiv-2501-18372.description: Abstract In recent years, significant advancements in computational methods have dramatically enhanced the precision in determining the energetic ranking of different phases of molecular crystals. The developments mainly focused on providing accurate dispersion corrected exchange correlation functionals and methods for describing the vibrational entropy contributions to the free energy at finite temperatures.

arxiv-2502-21151.title: A Review on Generative AI for Text-to-Image and Image-to-Image Generation and Implications to Scientific Images
arxiv-2502-21151.creator: Zineb Sordo, Eric Chagnon, Daniela Ushizima
arxiv-2502-21151.description: Abstract This review surveys the state-of-the-art in text-to-image and image-to-image generation within the scope of generative AI. We provide a comparative analysis of three prominent architectures: Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks and Diffusion Models. For each, we elucidate core concepts, architectural innovations, and practical strengths and limitations, particularly for scientific image understanding.

pmc-13433729.creator: Man Li, Xiao Wang, Pengen Li, Hongjie Gong, Jianbing Wu, Ye Mao
pmc-13433729.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is one of the most aggressive gastrointestinal cancers, with over 90% of cases harboring KRAS gene mutations. These mutations not only serve as key drivers of tumorigenesis but also reshape the tumor microenvironment (TME), creating a highly immunosuppressive “cold tumor” characterized by immune cell dysfunction, a dense fibrotic stroma, and a unique metabolic state.

pmc-13550105.creator: Takeru HIRATA, Satoshi KOIZUMI, Hideaki ONO, Satoru MIYAWAKI, Shigeta FUJITANI, Motoyuki UMEKAWA, Nobuhito SAITO
pmc-13550105.description: Anterior skull base meningiomas are often supplied by ethmoidal arteries branching from the ophthalmic artery. Preoperative embolization can reduce intraoperative bleeding and facilitate safer resection; however, its use is limited by the risk of visual complications. This study evaluates the safety, effectiveness, and technical considerations of embolization via the ophthalmic artery using n-butyl-2-cyanoacrylate (n-BCA).
